brand.name: RoadwiseFleet
app.title: Fleet Manager — RoadwiseFleet
login.title: Sign in to Fleet Manager
login.lead: Use your RoadwiseFleet account. Dispatchers, accountants and drivers all sign in here.
login.helper: Use the account you created for your fleet.
signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: Choose how you use RoadwiseFleet: as a customer, as a fleet, or as a solo truck driver.
signup.name: Your name
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
signup.error.formInvalid: The form could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
signup.error.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, for example you@company.com.
signup.error.passwordShort: Use a password with at least 8 characters.
signup.error.passwordLong: That password is too long. Use 200 characters or fewer.
signup.error.accountTypeInvalid: Choose an account type: customer, fleet or solo truck driver.
account.type.customerHint: Book loads and track your shipments. Free.
account.type.fleetHint: Run a fleet with drivers and vehicles. EUR 20/month after 1 free month.
account.type.soloDriverHint: Drive on your own, free of charge.
overview.title: Overview
overview.body: You are signed in to the Fleet Manager shell. The dashboard KPIs, trips list and dispatch tools plug into this layout as each function lands.
overview.roleNav: Your navigation is limited to what your role may do.
dashboard.lead: Today at a glance — every number is computed from your company's own data.
dashboard.driverTitle: Your day is on My trips
dashboard.driverBody: The dashboard is for dispatchers, accountants and the owner. Your assigned trips, statuses and document capture are on My trips.
dashboard.loadFailed: Could not load the dashboard. Try again.
dispatch.lead: Create a trip from your company's orders — pick an order, then a driver and a truck. There are no IDs to type.
dispatch.customerHint: This comes from the order; choose a different order to change it.
dispatch.rateHint: Optional. A non-negative amount; leave it empty if the rate is agreed later.
dispatch.plannedHint: Optional. The promised delivery time; the on-time KPI compares the actual delivery against it.
dispatch.draftNote: The trip is created as a draft.
dispatch.loadFailed: Could not load the orders, drivers and trucks. Try again.
dispatch.noOrders: There are no orders yet. Add an order first, then dispatch it.
dispatch.fixErrors: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
dispatch.error.orderUnknown: That order is not in the list. Pick one from the dropdown.
dispatch.error.driverUnknown: That driver is not in the list. Pick one from the dropdown.
dispatch.error.truckUnknown: That truck is not in the list. Pick one from the dropdown.
dispatch.error.rate: Enter the rate as euros (0 or more), or leave it empty.
dispatch.error.plannedAt: Enter the planned delivery as a valid date and time, or leave it empty.
dispatch.error.customerMismatch: The customer does not match the selected order. Reload the page and pick the order again.
dispatch.error.invalidInput: The server rejected a field: {detail}. Fix it and try again.
dispatch.error.orderNotFound: That order no longer exists in your company. Refresh the list and pick another.
dispatch.error.driverNotFound: That driver no longer exists in your company. Pick another.
dispatch.error.truckNotFound: That truck no longer exists in your company. Pick another.
assign.title: Driver
assign.hint: Reassigning keeps the trip's status and is recorded on the timeline by the person who did it.
assign.closed: This trip is closed; the driver can no longer be changed.
assign.loadFailed: Could not load the driver list. Try again.
assign.error.unknownDriver: That driver is not in the list. Pick one from the dropdown.
assign.error.alreadyAssigned: That driver is already on this trip.
assign.error.tripClosed: This trip is closed; the driver can no longer be changed.
assign.error.conflict: The trip changed while you were working. Reload the page and try again.
assign.error.driverUnavailable: That driver is suspended and cannot take a trip. Choose another driver.
assign.error.driverNotFound: That driver no longer exists in your company. Pick another.
assign.error.tripNotFound: That trip no longer exists in your company. Go back to the trips list.
assign.error.invalidInput: The server rejected the assignment: {detail}. Fix it and try again.
error.invalidCredentials: That email and password did not match. Check both and try again.
error.emailTaken: That email is already registered. Sign in instead, or use another email address.
error.accountLocked: This account is locked after too many failed attempts. Ask your fleet owner to unlock it, or try again in 15 minutes.
error.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
error.forbidden: Your role does not have access to this. Ask your fleet owner if you need it.
error.noOrg: This account is not attached to a company. Ask your fleet owner to finish the setup.
error.badRequest: Something in the request was not valid. Check the fields and try again.
error.requiredFields: Enter your email and password to sign in.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your fleet owner.
error.network: No connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
error.notFoundBody: That page does not exist in the app. Use the navigation to pick a screen.
error.loadFailed: Could not load your session. Try again.
trips.filterBadRange: The "from" date is after the "to" date. Adjust the range and try again.
trips.filterInvalid: The server rejected the filter "{field}". Adjust it and try again.
trips.empty: No trips yet. Create one from Dispatch.
trips.emptyFiltered: No trips match these filters. Widen or reset them.
trips.noDocuments: No documents uploaded for this trip.
trips.noExpenses: No expenses recorded for this trip.
docs.lead: Documents are managed per trip. Pick a trip below to upload its paperwork, check the required documents and verify or reject what a driver sent.
docs.alternative: Required — either this or the alternative
docs.gateReady: POD requirement met — this trip can move to POD uploaded.
docs.gateMissing: A proof of delivery or eCMR is still required before this trip can move to POD uploaded.
docs.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or PDF, up to {max}.
docs.empty: No trips are at a stage that needs documents right now. Open a trip from the Trips list to manage its paperwork.
docs.error.mime: That file type is not supported. Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or PDF file.
docs.error.tooLarge: Photo is {size} — the maximum is {max}. Choose a smaller file.
docs.error.tooLargeServer: The server refused the file because it is too large. Choose a smaller file.
docs.error.capture: The capture time or location was not valid. Try the upload again.
docs.error.file: That file could not be read. Choose it again and retry.
docs.error.filename: That file name cannot be used. Rename the file and try again.
docs.error.status: That is not a document status you can set. Reload the page and try again.
docs.error.notFound: That document no longer exists. Reload the trip and try again.
docs.error.storage: The file could not be stored. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell your fleet owner.
driver.lead: Your trips, one tap at a time. Advance a status, attach the paperwork and photograph the proof of delivery.
driver.empty: You have no trips right now. Pull to refresh after dispatch assigns you one.
driver.noActions: No status change is available for this trip.
driver.podGate: Attach a proof of delivery or eCMR before moving this trip to POD uploaded.
driver.capture.unavailable: The capture helper is not available. Reload the page and try again.
driver.confirm.DELIVERED: Mark this trip as delivered? This cannot be undone.
driver.capture.title: Photograph a document
driver.capture.hint: Take the photo now: the capture time and, when available, the GPS position are attached automatically.
driver.capture.metaNoGps: Captured {at}. No GPS fix was available.
driver.photo.tooLargeServer: The photo was refused because it is over the {max} limit. Choose a smaller photo and try again.
driver.gps.coarse: The GPS fix is too imprecise to attach; the capture will keep the timestamp.
driver.gps.denied: No GPS position available; the capture will keep the timestamp.
driver.queued: Offline: {count} change(s) queued and will sync when you are back online.
driver.queuedCapture: Offline: {count} item(s) queued, including this photo. They sync when you are back online.
driver.queue.full: This photo is too large to keep offline. Reconnect and upload it now.
tracking.title: Tracking link
tracking.lead: Share a trip with a customer without giving them an account. Mint a link, copy it in one click, and revoke it when the delivery is done.
tracking.state.none: No active link. Create one to share this trip.
tracking.state.expired: The link has expired. Create a new one to share this trip again.
tracking.copyManual: Copy is not available here — the link is selected; copy it with your keyboard.
tracking.revoked: Tracking link revoked. The shared link no longer works.
tracking.confirmRevoke: Revoke this tracking link? Anyone holding it will lose access immediately.
tracking.empty: No trips to track yet. Create a trip first.
tracking.error.notFound: That trip no longer exists in your company. Go back to the trips list.
tracking.error.invalid: That tracking link is not valid or has expired.
live.title: Live tracking
live.state.live: Live — the driver is on the road.
live.notStarted.hint: The driver turns tracking on with Start Trip.
live.unavailable: The live stream is unavailable right now — it reconnects when the page is reloaded.
reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.lead: After some deliveries we ask you to rate the customer — and the customer rates you. Both sides are asked at most once every ten deliveries; a rating stays hidden until both sides have had their chance.
reviews.empty: No reviews to give right now.
reviews.already: You have already reviewed this delivery.
